pages.text: $(li)Click stations with a $(item)Timetable$(), in the order the train should call at them (up to 16). Its tooltip lists them.$(li)Fuel the locomotive, and click any car of the train with the timetable. Off it goes.$(br2)It runs to each station in turn and round again, waiting at each.

It picks its way at junctions, stops for red signals, keeps to speed limits, and backs out of dead ends (or turns on a turntable).$(br2)Climb into the cab and touch the throttle or brake to take over; sneak-click the train with the timetable to stop it. Sneak-click the air to clear the timetable.
Two timetabled trains share a signalled loop.
